title: Primary garden area within the primary street setback area
text: C1.1.5 Notwithstanding C1.1.3, a single consolidated primary garden area may be located within the primary street setback area where any street walls or fences within the primary street setback area are visually permeable in accordance with C3.6.5 and C3.6.6.

replaces.note: Part C requires the PGA behind the primary street setback

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: diverges: coding R30-R80, R80-equivalent codes and R100-SL (PGA applies from R30 in Chapter 3, p10; Chapter 2 from R50). Applies only where the PGA is in the primary street setback area (rule condition). Same test as the exception on C1.1.3-r3.
